title: Anthropic's $11.5B quarter
angle: The AI spend is real, and it is coming from working practitioners.

frames.text: Anthropic did $11.5B in a quarter and turned a profit.
Preliminary revenue, up from $4.73B the previous quarter.
Twelve months earlier. That's not growth, that's a different company.
Positive operating income, earlier than most people had it modelled.
Preliminary numbers, shown to investors ahead of a possible IPO.
The spend is real, and a lot of it comes from people like me.
